name: Lake Level MCP
description: Live US lake and reservoir water levels for 44 lakes in 12 states, read at call time from USGS, USACE CWMS, CDEC, Reclamation and TWDB gauges. Tools: search_lakes, get_lake_level, get_lake_history (up to 365 days) and compare_lakes. No API key.
author: theluckystrike
